list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Add interactive input fallback to Main for IDE runs
- When started with no command-line arguments (e.g. from an IDE), Main now asks for the map file name and tick count on the console and runs once the file is found; it re-prompts on a missing file or invalid number. - Command-line usage (java -jar ObjectVilleGame.jar <map> <ticks>) is unchanged. Prompts go to stderr, so the simulation output on stdout stays byte-for-byte identical in both modes. - Refactor Main: extract parseTicks, askMapFile, askTicks and runSimulation. Existing argument/tick validation logic is unchanged, only moved. - README: add a short "Running in an IDE" note.
Only Main.java changed; all other classes are untouched
